rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. It does not apply to units that received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, or certain HUD-subsidized units.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases). Not rent controlled (partially covered): new construction built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies; units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or Project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a mortgage insured or held by HUD.
rules.exemptions: Fully exempt: "Golden Duplex" (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley’s Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – just cause coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to both fully covered and partially covered units, including new construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and listed subsidized units. Exempt units are not covered.
rules.coverage_text: Fully and partially covered units, including multifamily units built before 1980, single family homes, rooming houses, new construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, most condominiums, and units with listed government subsidies.
rules.exemptions: "Golden Duplex" (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley’s Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
